title: Everyday SKS - Pathfinder
deviation_alts: Starfall Polar Jelly, Lunar Snow Sprite
hide_crafting: Starfall Cowhide on mask, lunar wolf/deer on chest, gold hide on shoes
notes: Bread-and-butter daily PvE build from gear-chat notes. Use <Deviant Energy> suffix mods until you farm ideal rolls. Keep Bullseye ready for heavy elite targets before detonating Frost Vortex. Earlier calibration notes, before calibration records existed: primary any except Rapid or Crit Rate; secondary Rapid, any stat.

title: Everyday Compound Bow - Burden Of Betrayal
deviation_alts: Soul Summoner, Lunar Lone Wolf's Whisper

notes: High mobility bounce clearing. Tag leader mobs with Bullseye, then arrow ricochets wipe packs in seconds. Can comfortably swap to 4 Renegade for even higher single target burst.
